_notes: Built from a live TSW7 session via `tsw-cli discover` + `tsw-cli get`/`set`, not guessed. Real notch counts and range came from this loco's own Function.GetNotchCount/GetMinimumInputValue/GetMaximumInputValue: PowerBrakeController is genuinely -1..1 (5 notches) unlike the Class 333's 0..1 combined handle -- confirmed by moving it live and watching InputValue snap to notch positions. MasterKey must be on and Reverser out of neutral before the loco responds to power/brake at all. No PZB/SIFA/LZB or ETCS (British EMU, not German-fitted). This unit's doors are a full guard-operated selective-door-opening (SDO) panel (PassengerDoor_FL/FR/BL/BR, GuardPanelDoor_L/R, GuardCloseDoors_L, GuardReleaseDoors_R, GuardASDO_L, GuardKey_R, DoorRelease_R, DoorsClose_L, plus per-door Open/Close Ext/Int variants) with no simple left/right toggle pair, so doors_left_toggle/doors_right_toggle are deliberately left unmapped here -- there's no clean 1:1 fit yet. Also unmapped on purpose: ReducedHorn (low-tone variant), CabLight_L/CabLight_R/CabReadingLight/ReadingLight (picked CabLight_Desk as the one 'cab light' mapping), TPWS_BrakeRelease/VigilanceIsolation/TPWS_TempIsolation (no matching logical name yet), BatteryOff, GSM-R radio panel buttons, and the guard's own signal/buzzer controls.
